qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) - AI/ML Scientist: Four years B.Tech degree in IT/CS with three years post qualification experience or Engineering degree in AI/ML. Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical): Postgraduate Degree in Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Molecular Biology/Biomedical Sciences with three years post-qualification experience or Ph.D. in relevant subject. Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): Postgraduate Degree in Biotechnology/Life Sciences/Molecular Biology/Biomedical Sciences or related background including integrated PG degree. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi has announced a total of 5 vacancies for various project-based posts, including Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) – AI/ML Scientist post?
faq.answer: For the Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical) – AI/ML Scientist position, candidates need a four-year B.Tech degree in IT/CS with three years of post-qualification experience or an Engineering degree in AI/ML.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these AIIMS Delhi posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts announced under this AIIMS Delhi recruitment is 40 years. Age relaxation rules may apply as per government guidelines, but this is the general upper limit.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this AIIMS Delhi recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I – Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-I – Field Investigator post offers a salary of ₹18,000 plus 30% HRA per month. This is an entry-level position within the project.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the AIIMS Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions at AIIMS Delhi will primarily be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview round.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: Interested candidates must apply via email. They need to prepare their application with all necessary details and documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110029. The recruitment is for positions within the institute in Delhi.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: These positions are contractual in nature, as indicated by the job type. They are project-based roles within AIIMS Delhi and not permanent government appointments.
